node-1.label: Slightly pruritic lesions on the face for 1 year

node-2.label: Patient is a girl younger than 2 years, born after an uncomplicated pregnancy and delivery, with growth and development appropriate for age

node-3.label: No associated symptoms such as fever, anorexia, or weight loss were noted

node-4.label: Physical examination revealed multiple skin-colored and erythematous follicular papules (1-2 mm) in a segmental pattern on the right forehead, dorsum and tip of nose; a small excoriated plaque on the right malar area; no mucosal lesions; rest of examination unremarkable
